d:
Argentina pulled off an INCREDIBLE 19-point comeback against Australia at the 2008 FIBA Diamond Ball!
With their backs against the wall, Argentina refused to give up. And leading the charge was the legendary Luis Scola, who delivered a MONSTER performance with 32 POINTS!
Argentina fought all the way back, took control in the closing moments and completed an unforgettable 95-91 victory over Australia!
Down 19, but NEVER out! This was Luis Scola and Argentina at their BEST!
